# Matanzas Inn

> > Matanzas Inn is a waterfront resort and marina in Fort Myers Beach, Florida, offering Gulf Coast accommodations, boat docking, and waterfront dining at Matanzas on the Bay.

Located in Southwest Florida, Matanzas Inn serves as a gateway to Fort Myers Beach adventures, water sports, and Gulf of Mexico experiences. The property features Matanzas Landing marina facilities and provides comprehensive guides to regional attractions including Lovers Key State Park, Edison and Ford Winter Estates, and Estero Bay activities.
